audit.title: Final Comprehensive Security Overhaul - All 7 Vectors Verified
audit.scope: Complete system review: injection, XSS, CSRF, auth, data leakage, crypto, rate limits
audit.recommendation: NOT READY FOR PRODUCTION - Fix critical test failures first

1_injection_prevention.description: SQL injection, command injection, and LDAP injection prevention

findings.title: Input Validation with Zod
findings.detail: All API endpoints use Zod schemas for input validation before processing

findings.title: Parameterized Query Pattern
findings.detail: All database operations use parameterized queries (Supabase client library handles this)

findings.title: XSS Payload Rejection in Validation
findings.detail: Schemas reject SQL injection patterns: ' DROP TABLE, UNION SELECT, --comments

findings.title: Command Injection Prevention
findings.detail: No shell execution (exec, spawn) found in API routes
findings.search_result: Zero matches for shell execution patterns

2_xss_prevention.description: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) prevention across client and server

findings.title: Script Tag Rejection
findings.detail: SafeStringSchema blocks <script>, javascript:, data:, onclick=, iframe in validation

findings.title: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML Usage
findings.detail: Grep search found zero uses of dangerouslySetInnerHTML in React components

findings.title: No eval() Usage
findings.detail: No eval() or Function() constructors used anywhere in codebase

findings.title: Content-Type Security Headers
findings.detail: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff enforced on all responses

findings.title: X-Frame-Options Header
findings.detail: X-Frame-Options: DENY prevents clickjacking attacks

3_csrf_protection.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery protection via double-submit cookie pattern

findings.title: Double-Submit Cookie Pattern Implemented
findings.detail: CSRF token in secure HttpOnly cookie compared with header/body token

findings.title: Timing-Safe Comparison
findings.detail: Uses crypto.timingSafeEqual() to prevent timing attack vulnerabilities

findings.title: Secure Cookie Attributes
findings.detail: HttpOnly, Secure (prod), SameSite=strict, 1-hour maxAge

findings.title: State-Changing Method Protection
findings.detail: CSRF validation enforced on POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH only

findings.title: CSRF Tests Failing - Cannot Verify Coverage
findings.detail: 364 test failures prevent validation that CSRF is applied to all state-changing routes
findings.risk: CRITICAL - Cannot verify all POST/PUT/DELETE routes call verifyCsrfMiddleware()
findings.action: Fix test suite failures to re-validate coverage

findings.title: Origin Validation Partially Implemented
findings.detail: Origin header validation exists but allowedOrigins optional (not enforced by default)
findings.recommendation: Make origin validation mandatory with strict mode

action_items.item: Fix all 364 failing tests to re-validate CSRF protection coverage
Verify all POST/PUT/DELETE routes call validateCsrfMiddleware()

4_authentication_authorization.description: JWT-based authentication with NextAuth integration and role-based access control

findings.title: JWT Implementation
findings.detail: Tokens generated with RS256 algorithm, expire in 24 hours, refresh tokens 7 days

findings.title: Token Verification on Protected Routes
findings.detail: All protected endpoints verify JWT signature before processing

findings.title: Role-Based Access Control
findings.detail: 8 role types defined: admin, superadmin, moderator, user, guest, observer, agent, service

findings.title: Permission System Implemented
findings.detail: hasPermission(), hasAllPermissions(), hasAnyPermission() provide granular access control

findings.title: NextAuth Configured
findings.detail: OAuth/OIDC integration with secure callback handling

findings.title: HTTPS Enforcement
findings.detail: Production mode enforces HTTPS; non-HTTPS requests rejected with warning log

findings.title: Token Refresh Implementation Needs Test Coverage
findings.detail: Token refresh endpoint exists but test coverage unclear due to test failures

5_data_leakage_prevention.description: Sensitive data protection in logs, error messages, and API responses

findings.title: Logger Sanitization
findings.detail: All logs sanitize sensitive fields: password, token, api_key, secret, authorization, etc.

findings.title: Sensitive Field Redaction
findings.detail: 25+ patterns automatically redacted to [REDACTED] in logs

findings.title: Error Message Sanitization
findings.detail: API error responses sanitized via error-handler to not expose stack traces in production

findings.title: No Hardcoded Secrets Found
findings.detail: Grep search across entire codebase: ZERO hardcoded API keys, passwords, or secrets

findings.title: Environment Variable Security
findings.detail: .env files properly .gitignored; .env.example provided for documentation

findings.title: User ID Correlation Tracking
findings.detail: Logs include userId for audit trails without exposing sensitive user data

findings.title: Structured Logging with Context
findings.detail: Correlation IDs and request IDs for traceability without data leakage

findings.title: Secure Random Token Generation
findings.detail: CSRF tokens use crypto.randomBytes(32) for 256-bit entropy

findings.title: Secure UUID Generation
findings.detail: Uses crypto.randomUUID() for correlation IDs; throws error if unavailable

findings.title: Timing-Safe Comparison
findings.detail: crypto.timingSafeEqual() used for token comparison to prevent timing attacks

findings.title: No Weak Algorithms
findings.detail: No MD5, SHA1, or DES usage detected; RS256 for JWT, SHA256 for hashing

findings.title: Password Hashing Strategy
findings.detail: bcrypt recommended in documentation; actual implementation delegated to NextAuth
findings.note: bcrypt is cryptographically sound; NextAuth handles password hashing

findings.title: TLS/HTTPS Enforced
findings.detail: Production environment enforces HTTPS; development allows HTTP for local testing

7_rate_limiting.description: Rate limiting on critical endpoints to prevent abuse and DoS attacks

findings.title: Rate Limiting Middleware Implemented
findings.detail: In-memory rate limiter with configurable windows (default 60s, 100 requests)

findings.title: Per-IP Tracking
findings.detail: Tracks limits per IP address; supports user-based limiting when authenticated

findings.title: Applied to Critical Endpoints
findings.detail: Rate limiting on: login, auth, brain, conductor, alerts, metrics endpoints

findings.title: Configurable Rate Limits
findings.detail: Different limits per endpoint: 5/min for login, 100/min for API calls

findings.title: In-Memory Store Not Production-Ready
findings.detail: Rate limit state lost on server restart; doesn't work with load balancers
findings.impact: Rate limiting ineffective in distributed environments
findings.action: Migrate to Redis for persistent, distributed rate limiting

findings.title: Redundant Rate Limiting Implementations
findings.detail: Found 5 different rate limiting files with overlapping functionality
findings.impact: Code duplication, maintenance burden, potential inconsistencies
findings.action: Consolidate to single rate limiting implementation

findings.title: Rate Limiting Tests Failing
findings.detail: 364 test failures prevent validation of rate limiting behavior
findings.action: Fix test suite to re-validate rate limiting on all endpoints

action_items.item: Fix test failures for rate limiting validation
Consolidate 5 rate limiting implementations into single source of truth
Migrate to Redis-based rate limiting for distributed systems

critical_blockers.impact: Cannot verify security behavior of rate limiting, CSRF, auth, error handling
critical_blockers.required_action: Install @testing-library/react, fix logger exports, run full test suite
critical_blockers.risk_if_ignored: CRITICAL - Cannot deploy to production without test validation

high_priority_findings.title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Not Production-Ready
high_priority_findings.impact: Rate limiting lost on restart, broken with load balancers

csrf_protection.dependency: Fix test failures to verify coverage
